_readme: Fill every null from the vendor's pricing page and set `accessed`. Nothing here is a real price until you do. bytes_per_vector: use bytes_per_vector_on_disk from `python -m eval.bench_latency synth`, or du -sb of your real LanceDB dir / vector count.

bytes_per_vector.note: Measured on disk via eval.bench_latency synth for 768-dim float32 vectors in LanceDB columnar format (3,074 bytes/vector)

instance_monthly_usd.note: AWS EC2 t4g.medium (2 vCPU, 4GB RAM, ARM64 Graviton2) Linux on-demand in us-east-1: $0.0336/hr * 730 hrs = $24.53/mo

storage_usd_per_gb_month.note: AWS S3 Standard storage (first 50 TB/month in us-east-1): $0.023 per GB-month

get_usd_per_1000_requests.note: AWS S3 Standard GET, SELECT, and all other requests: $0.0004 per 1,000 requests

gets_per_query.note: LanceDB zero-copy columnar reads against S3 manifest and index partitions average 3 GET requests per vector query

tiers.note: Pinecone 1x s1 pod ($0.096/hr * 730 hr = $70.08/mo) holding up to 100K-500K 768d vectors with in-memory HNSW
Pinecone 2x s1 pods ($140.16/mo) required to hold 1M 768d vectors with graph overhead in 24/7 RAM
Pinecone 20x s1 pods ($1,401.60/mo) required to support 10M 768d vectors in-memory

storage_usd_per_gb_month.note: Pinecone Serverless storage rate: $0.25 per GB-month

usd_per_million_read_units.note: Pinecone Serverless Standard read rate: $8.25 per 1,000,000 Read Units (RCUs)

read_units_per_query.note: Pinecone serverless formula: 1 Read Unit per k=5 top-k vector query on a single namespace
